MESMERIST SKILLS

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000337]{False Face} 【Max SL 3】

As a free action, spend up to (SL x 10) MP to become a visual duplicate of any creature for (1 + 1 per 10 MP spent) rounds. Anyone attacking a creature identical to you must randomly choose among all such identical creatures except itself. You may reveal yourself as a free action to end the effect.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000338]{Fear Itself}

When you cast an offensive spell targeting only one creature, increase its total MP cost by 5 to calculate the target's base Magic Defense from Willpower instead of Insight.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000339]{Ritual Mesmerism}

You may perform Rituals within the Mesmerism discipline; Mesmerism Rituals use (WLP + WLP) for the Magic Check.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000340]{Mesmerist Magic} 【Max SL 10】

Each time you acquire this skill, learn one Mesmerist Spell. Offensive Mesmerist Spells use (WLP + WLP) for the Magic Check.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000341]{Hall of Mirrors} 【Max SL 2】

When you use False Face targeting a non-ally, raise its total MP cost by up to (SL x 10) to spawn one additional illusion per 10 MP. An enemy attacking may make a (WLP + INS) Opposed Check against you; on success it picks one identical target at random, otherwise it hits and destroys an illusion for no damage.
